about.en: AFC is the official fan token of Arsenal Football Club. It is issued by Socios.com (Chiliz) as a CAP-20 token on Chiliz Chain at 0x76088F3eD5dC655De9295D93868ec1EeC654A615, with bridged representations on Base and Solana, and gives holders voting rights in club polls, rewards and fan-engagement features; it carries no ownership of the club.
